DirectorDecisionPlan.title: DirectorDecisionPlan

ProjectDirectorShadowComparison.title: ProjectDirectorShadowComparison

ProjectDirectorSourceSelectionAuditEntry.description: Bind one model disposition to the planner's final SHADOW EDL outcome.
ProjectDirectorSourceSelectionAuditEntry.title: ProjectDirectorSourceSelectionAuditEntry

ProjectDirectorStrategyCandidate.description: A non-confirmable project Plan/EDL generated from one SHADOW hypothesis.

candidate_binding_digest.description: SHA-256 binding to the exact project evidence scope, stable DirectorBrief, Plan and EDL state, strategy hypothesis, reasoning trace, decisions, and materialized EDL behavior. Generated artifact IDs and timestamps are excluded. A matching digest is required before a later formal generation can reuse a candidate.
candidate_binding_digest.title: Candidate Binding Digest

sequence_changed_vs_heuristic.description: Whether the ordered source identities differ from the heuristic baseline; does not compare trims, transitions, audio, or effects.
sequence_changed_vs_heuristic.title: Sequence Changed Vs Heuristic

distinct_edl_sequence_from_baseline.description: Whether the materialized EDL execution signature differs from the heuristic baseline, including source intervals, transitions, audio offsets, effects, and output tracks; provenance-only metadata is excluded.
distinct_edl_sequence_from_baseline.title: Distinct Edl Sequence From Baseline

distinct_edl_sequence_from_other_candida.description: Whether this candidate's materialized EDL execution signature is unique among the strategy candidates, including source intervals, transitions, audio offsets, effects, and output tracks.
distinct_edl_sequence_from_other_candida.title: Distinct Edl Sequence From Other Candidates

ProjectDirectorStrategyCandidate.title: ProjectDirectorStrategyCandidate

ProjectNarrativeCallProvenance.description: Content-free request scope for one successful project Reasoner call.

provider_identity_state.description: Whether the response envelope reported a model identifier or system fingerprint; this is not an immutable model revision or quality admission.
provider_identity_state.title: Provider Identity State

provider_reported_model.description: Model identifier returned by the provider response envelope, if any.
provider_reported_model.title: Provider Reported Model

provider_reported_system_fingerprint.description: System fingerprint returned by the provider response envelope, if any.
provider_reported_system_fingerprint.title: Provider Reported System Fingerprint

verified_model_digest.description: Exact Ollama model digest verified against the local model catalog immediately before this provider call.
verified_model_digest.title: Verified Model Digest

verified_runtime_version.description: Ollama runtime version verified immediately before this provider call.
verified_runtime_version.title: Verified Runtime Version

ProjectNarrativeCallProvenance.title: ProjectNarrativeCallProvenance

ProjectNarrativeConstraintAssessment.description: Unverified per-strategy review suggestion for one exact Brief entry.

candidate_edl_source_asset_alignment.description: Mechanical source-asset identity overlap with the candidate EDL; does not establish cited time-range overlap or semantic constraint truth.
candidate_edl_source_asset_alignment.title: Candidate Edl Source Asset Alignment

ProjectNarrativeConstraintAssessment.title: ProjectNarrativeConstraintAssessment

ProjectNarrativeEvidenceClaim.description: One strategy rationale statement tied to exact project evidence.
ProjectNarrativeEvidenceClaim.title: ProjectNarrativeEvidenceClaim

ProjectNarrativeEvidenceRef.description: Exact semantic observation supplied to a project narrative hypothesis.
ProjectNarrativeEvidenceRef.title: ProjectNarrativeEvidenceRef

ProjectNarrativeReasoningTrace.description: Unverified project narrative hypotheses with exact input lineage.

caller_asserted_link_hints_supplied.description: Caller-asserted link hints supplied as unverified context; this does not establish that the model used or accepted them.

caller_asserted_link_hint_ids_supplied.description: Stable IDs of caller link hints supplied to the provider.

caller_asserted_link_review_link_count.title: Caller Asserted Link Review Link Count

TransitionSpec.description:
转场规格（挂在出点侧：本镜头与下一镜头之间；P2-b 证据包裁定）。

type="cut" 为硬切（渲染器 concat 路径，缺省行为）；
type="xfade" 走链式 xfade/acrossfade（总时长 = Σd − ΣD，时间线由
:mod:`director_brain.timeline` 统一计算，字幕自动跟随）。
TransitionSpec.title: TransitionSpec

schema.description:
Persist a SHADOW comparison for audit and restart readback only.

The stored candidate text remains local to the project's SQLite repository.
This record is immutable, cannot be confirmed, and does not imply quality
acceptance or pathway admission.
schema.title: ProjectDirectorShadowComparisonRecord
